---
title: "Teaching"
description: "Courses, classes, workshops, notebooks, and reproducible training materials."
---

Teaching materials will be linked from dedicated `type-training` repositories rather than copied into the website repository.

## Publication model

A training repository may contain:

- Quarto lessons (`.qmd`);
- Jupyter notebooks (`.ipynb`);
- R or Python examples;
- exercises and supporting data;
- rendered course documentation.

The website will provide the catalogue entry and stable navigation, while each training repository remains the source of truth for its instructional content and version history.
